verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only general speed marketing, such as "Payments arrive as soon as the same day" and stablecoin payments that "settle in minutes." Nothing documents an exact, per-transfer delivery estimate shown for an ACH or wire before the user confirms it. Generic speed claims are adjacent and do not deliver the story.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can see the exact delivery estimate for an ACH or wire transfer before confirming it
